goal: Quantify how much the historical backtest universe can be expanded before designing any new trading rule.

KALSHI.population: settled events returned by the public Events API
KALSHI.historical_price_support: live/historical market candlesticks and historical trades

POLYMARKET.population: reuse already-materialized W2-C performance-blind discovery and semantic results; no new return read

MANIFOLD.population: resolved binary markets returned by the public API
MANIFOLD.historical_price_support: bets/trades API and non-commercial bulk dumps
MANIFOLD.restriction: do not pool with regulated/real-money venues in the primary backtest without a separate protocol

census_outputs: number of recurring Kalshi series per family
Manifold token mix and resolved-binary counts
existing Polymarket accepted counts carried forward without performance reads
lower-bound union capacity before cross-venue deduplication
forbidden_inputs: family selection based on realized alpha
post-census keyword edits intended to inflate a family
promotion_rule: This census may prioritize data-engineering work only. It cannot authorize a trading strategy or W4 backtest until a separate population, signal, portfolio, inference and multiplicity protocol is preregistered and frozen.

target_design_goal.note: targets are collection/design goals, not claims that these Ns are currently available
